messages:
mira: Quick design sync: trying to finalize microcopy + keyboard flow for the KMS + region step in the retention modal. Looking for accessibility, audit, and legal nits.

jas: pasted the latest figma. Two things: (1) the modal shows a short explainer under each KMS option, (2) region selector shows country flags + short code.

noah: Accessibility concerns first: flags alone are not accessible. Region select needs aria-label "Processing region" and the visible label should be full country name (eg. "United States"). Also the helper text should be referenced by aria-describedby on the select.

eva: Compliance/legal: avoid definitive promises about export. Proposed safe lines: "Redwood-managed: Redwood stores and rotates keys; Redwood does not provide access to key material." and "Customer-managed (BYOK): Uses your KMS; export and rotation depend on your KMS configuration and policy." Short, clear.

mira: thanks. We also have the edge-case where switching region triggers a background re-encryption job. UX needs to warn about potential delay and list that as a note. Suggest microcopy: "Note: changing region may re-encrypt recent data; this can take up to 24 hours."

jas: For the modal actions, primary is Save, secondary Cancel. If user changes KMS or region and hits Cancel, we should show a small toast: "Changes discarded" not a modal. If they try to close the modal with unsaved changes (Escape or X) show a confirm dialog: "You have unsaved changes. Discard?"

noah: Keyboard flow proposal: (1) focus first KMS radio, (2) Tab -> explainer expander toggle (aria-expanded), (3) Tab -> region select, (4) Tab -> Save (primary). When explainer expands, focus the content start so screen reader users hear the details. Escape behavior: Escape collapses open explainer first, and only after that closes modal (standard pattern).

eva: Audit event naming: we need a machine id that follows our schema and a human-friendly message. Proposal machine id = `audit.kms.region.update.v1`. Human message = "{user} updated KMS to {kms} and processing region to {region} for org {org}". Also include fields: previous_kms, previous_region, ip, request_id. Please alias current legacy id `audit.kms.change` for 6 months.

mira: dev note: changing the machine id will require aliasing listeners. Can product own the alias plan? We'll put required aliases in the PR description.

jas: small copy tweak: the BYOK chip currently reads "BYOK" which users don't understand. Change to a small inline chip: "Customer-managed (BYOK) — requires KMS admin" and add a tooltip link "What is BYOK?" that opens docs in a new tab. Tooltip must be keyboard accessible.

noah: for tootips and links opening new tabs, include aria-label "opens in new tab" and rel attrs on links. Also avoid relying on hover-only reveal.

eva: legal wants the phrase "requires KMS admin" only when the user does not have the right permission. So show the chip text, but only surface exact permission callout when the app can detect user's role. Otherwise keep it generic.

mira: good call. We'll show chip text and if we detect user lacks permission show an inline inline-warning banner: "You need KMS admin privileges to select this option."

jas: UI detail: ensure BYOK chip color meets AA contrast. Use design tokens: `--color-warning-600` + `--color-on-warning`. Also badges should be implemented with semantic <span role="status"> to be announced.

noah: aria role status for the badge is ok, but be careful: screen readers may announce repeated status messages. Only set role=status when content changes. For static labels rely on aria-label and visible text.

ops-bot: heads-up: design tokens branch `design/kms-region-ux` merged at 1880001205. CI: passed.

mira: final checklist before handoff to eng: 1) adopt eva's safe export wording, 2) show full country name with aria-describedby hint, 3) explainer collapsible must set aria-expanded + focus management, 4) unsaved-changes confirm on modal close, 5) audit machine id + alias plan per eva, 6) BYOK chip text + conditional permission banner, 7) toast copy for discard vs save. I'll bundle copy into a single file for the PR.

jas: I'll update figma + attach keyboard prototype.

noah: I'll draft the aria notes and send a short testing checklist for QA.

eva: I'll add the audit payload template to the PR and confirm alias retention window.

mira: thanks all. Posting final copy + assets in ~1h. :thumbsup:
